commentary.text: 90+5' Jose Sanchez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Alaves.
90+3' Izeta (Ath Bilbao) is punished with the yellow card.
90+2' A yellow card for a tackle by Pablo Ibanez (Alaves). Jose Sanchez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Victor Parada (Alaves) is coming onto the pitch as Moussa Diarra cannot continue after picking up an injury.
88' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
86' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Sanchez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
85' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
84' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
81' The attendance for today's match is 49136.
80' Here is a change. Alex Berenguer is going off and Jon Aspiazu gives the last tactical orders to Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao).
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Izeta (Ath Bilbao) is replacing Inaki Williams.
79' Facundo Garces (Alaves) commits a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for an infringement.
76' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon makes a decent save to stop the effort.
76' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Carles Alena and he is replaced by Jon Pacheco (Alaves).
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
72' Jose Sanchez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Moussa Diarra (Alaves) and blew his whistle.
70' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Antonio Sivera.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) will replace Oihan Sancet.

67' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom left corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Antonio Sivera.
64' Flag goes up against Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
61' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
61' The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao win a corner kick.
61' Toni Martinez (Alaves) is flagged for offside.
59' Jon Aspiazu decides to make a substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta will be replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
59' Substitution. Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) has come on for Gorka Guruzeta.
57' 0 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the roof of his own net.
57' Alaves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
56' Corner kicks – 3:3.
54' The game is interrupted. Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
53' The foul by Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Sanchez.
52' Jose Sanchez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Antonio Blanco (Alaves).

52' Toni Martinez (Alaves) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
50' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
49' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) has received a yellow card for his foul.
48' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation.
46' Eduardo Coudet has made a change at the break. Lucas Boye has come on in place of Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
46' Half-time substitution. Mariano Diaz (Alaves) is replaced by Toni Martinez.
46' Eduardo Coudet makes a switch. Denis Suarez is coming on in place of Jon Guridi (Alaves) at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Jose Sanchez blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the right post.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The percentage of ball possession is – 63:37.

43' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the bottom left corner. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Antonio Sivera and his brilliant save.
42' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
42' The free kick from long range, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.
41' Poor challenge! Jon Guridi (Alaves) is penalised for tripping and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle.
40' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
39' Dangerous play by Carles Alena (Alaves). Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Jose Sanchez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Facundo Garces (Alaves).
36' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
35' Looks like Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
34' The corner from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is cleared away by the defence.
33' Mariano Diaz (Alaves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
30' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Mariano Diaz (Alaves), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
30' A lofted pass picks out Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
27' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) sends a chip pass into the box, but Antonio Sivera is quickest to intercept the ball.
25' Carles Alena (Alaves) works the corner short.
25' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Alaves can continue in their attacking effort.

24' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
21' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jonny Otto (Alaves). Jose Sanchez saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
15' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) gets his head on the corner, but he sees his header blocked.
15' Carles Alena (Alaves) will take a corner kick.
13' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Jose Sanchez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
10' The linesman raises his flag. Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is adjudged offside.
10' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
9' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao). Ath Bilbao have a corner.
8' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) trips an opposition player and Jose Sanchez signals a foul.
5' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for holding. Jose Sanchez signals a set piece.
3' Carles Alena (Alaves) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
1' Mariano Diaz (Alaves) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Alaves will have the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez will supervise the game today.
